description: This file implements the DataElement class and related functionalities within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes CRC32 checksum calculations, buffer management, and data copying for linked data elements.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Class responsible for handling data elements, including CRC32 checksum calculation over its buffer.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Class managing linked buffer data with methods for getting/setting buffers and copying data across linked elements.

methods.name: uint32_t CRC32(const uint64_t offset,const uint64_t size) const
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for a specified range within the DataElement buffer.

methods.name: void GetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,uint8_t * buffer) const
methods.description: Retrieves a portion of the buffer from a linked data element, handling boundary crossing.

methods.name: void SetBuffer(uint64_t offset,uint32_t size,const uint8_t * buffer)
methods.description: Sets a portion of the buffer in a linked data element, handling boundary crossing.

methods.name: uint64_t Copy(const uint64_t offset,const LinkedDataElement & copy)
methods.description: Copies data from another linked data element into this one, spanning multiple linked elements if necessary.
